description: San Francisco County (FIPS 06075) assessor secured roll for the FactLot Registry collector. Review record: docs/registry/sources/ca-san-francisco-assessor.md.

sources.publisher: City and County of San Francisco, Office of the Assessor-Recorder (via DataSF)
sources.license: Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License (PDDL 1.0), stated in the dataset's own metadata (licenseId PDDL, termsLink opendatacommons.org/licenses/pddl/1.0/)
sources.ai_use: Not restricted: PDDL grants a worldwide, royalty-free licence to Use the Work, and the dataset carries no AI clause
sources.notes: Socrata dataset wv5m-vpq2 'Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls' (Assessor-Recorder inventory ID ASR-0001), one row per parcel per roll year (closed_roll_year = leading year of the fiscal year), updated annually after the roll closes (rows last updated 2026-06-26). The file is the SODA CSV filtered to one roll year AND to the in-scope property_class_code values listed in ca_san_francisco.py (the full roll is 211,547 rows and the publisher's SODA stream of it kept stalling and dropping, so the collector archives the commercial-class extract, 20,612 rows, 5.5 MB, with a 23-column projection of the 46 columns); it is a partial extract, so ingest it with full_roll off; change closed_roll_year in the URL when the next roll appears (the 2026 roll was not yet published on 2026-11-02; latest was 2025). The file has NO owner names (the Assessor-Recorder publishes none in this dataset). Reference tables: use/class codes pa56-ek2h, exemption codes g77e-ikb4. robots.txt on data.sf.gov: Crawl-delay 1, no rule covering /resource/ or /api/views/. The DataSF terms page on sf.gov answered with an empty HTTP 202 (CDN challenge) to the collector, so its text was not read directly; the licence rests on the dataset metadata and the PDDL 1.0 text.
